semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Seimitsu is a leading manufacturer of precision measuring instruments and semiconductor production equipment, directly contributing to the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co., Ltd. specializes in high precision measuring instruments and semiconductor production equipment, including probing machines, dicing machines, and polish grinders. Established in 1949, the company focuses on enhancing productivity for its customers through advanced technology and robust customer support.

regional_presence.Japan: Tokyo Seimitsu is one of Japan's leading manufacturers in the semiconductor equipment sector.
